bottom_line: Fed holds rates while ECB cuts, widening the transatlantic rate differential and strengthening the dollar against the euro.
what_changed: FOMC held the federal funds rate unchanged at its latest meeting while the ECB proceeded with a 25bp cut.
why_it_matters: Rate divergence affects EUR/USD, dollar-denominated debt servicing costs, and capital flows to emerging markets.
main_uncertainty: Fed forward guidance suggests data-dependent approach; next meeting could go either way.

scenarios.name: Convergence
scenarios.description: Fed cuts at next meeting, narrowing differential.

scenarios.name: Sustained divergence
scenarios.description: Fed holds through year-end; EUR/USD approaches parity.
